verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph API for OneDrive exposes REST endpoints (driveItem access, upload sessions, delta query, search) that could be scripted headlessly in CI pipelines, and delta/change-notification APIs are inherently automation-oriented. However, there's no explicit documentation of a CLI, service-principal/app-only auth flow for CI, or any headless automation guide/example — missing for 10: dedicated CLI or headless tool, explicit CI/CD automation documentation, service-principal auth setup guidance, independent evidence of it being run in CI pipelines.
